newsitem.title: USA: Asia Pulp Chinese paper venture approved.
newsitem.headline: Asia Pulp Chinese paper venture approved.

text.p: Asia Pulp and Paper Co Ltd said on Wednesday it received approval from the Chinese State Planning Commission to build a greenfield paper and packaging joint venture plant in China for an estimated total cost of $1.5 billion to $1.8 billion.

While Asia Pulp said it was actively pursuing the project, it was still subject to negotiation of definitive joint venture contracts and financing arrangements and other final Chinese government approvals.

If all went as planned, Asia Pulp said the facility would have two paper machines with combined annual capacity of 500,000 to 700,000 tonnes and a boxboard or linerboard machine with annual capacity of about 450,000 tonnes.
The estimated total cost included the purchase of machinery, plant construction costs and costs of establishing a co-generation facility.
